businesses.business: industrial asset integrity and mechanical services

offering_description.value: Provides industrial services that keep critical assets safe and operating, including inspection, nondestructive testing, heat treating, leak repair, on-stream repair, mechanical and valve services, and engineering assessment. Serves refining, petrochemical, power, pipeline, and other industrial facilities, delivered by field technicians and specialized crews at customer sites.

primary_services.value: inspection and nondestructive testing; leak repair and on-stream services; heat treating; mechanical and valve repair; engineering and asset integrity assessment

customer_segment.value: B2B: refineries, petrochemical plants, power generators, pipeline operators, and other industrial facility owners

end_markets.value: refining and petrochemical; power generation; pipelines and midstream; oil and gas; chemicals; aerospace and manufacturing

revenue_model.value: service fees: time-and-materials and fixed-rate field services such as inspection, repair, and maintenance; project or contract: turnaround projects and master service agreements at industrial plants

value_chain_position.value: service provider: deploys technicians, equipment and engineering expertise to industrial plant owners and operators

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe, Middle East, Asia Pacific and Latin America, with US as the main market

specialization.value: related lines: inspection and heat treating, and mechanical and leak repair services for industrial assets

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: field service branches and account teams selling to plant owners under master service agreements

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: industrial safety, pressure equipment and pipeline inspection codes, OSHA, API, ASME standards and environmental rules

notes: Company may have divested units and reshaped segments; details are from general knowledge.
